description: This file defines configuration helpers for an OpenClaw project, including functions to create legacy provider configurations and configurations with fallbacks. It exports constants and functions used for setting up configurations involving models and providers, with references to external type definitions.

methods.name: export function createLegacyProviderConfig(params: { createLegacyProviderConfig
methods.description: Creates an OpenClawConfig object with provider details, including base URL, API key, model ID, and name, with default values if not provided.
